en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a large, ornate neo‑Renaissance school building on a street corner. The multi‑storey structure has tall windows, decorative cornices, and a mansard roof. A wrought‑iron fence and trees line the street in front, with groups of people standing on the sidewalk. In the background there is a smaller building. The sky is lightly clouded. Printed captions in a South Slavic language identify the scene as a gymnasium (secondary school) and send greetings from Bjelovar.
